About - Rainforest Retreat
Skip to content
Rainforest is located in Franz Josef Village close to the glacier of the same name on New Zealand’s West Coast, 5 hours drive from both Christchurch and
Queenstown airports. Rainforest is committed to environmental stewardship and is proud to promote the Tiaki Promise.
Contact us by email
Use our easy contact form or email us direct on [email protected] .
Contact us by phone
Give us a call on +64 3 752 0220 or toll free in NZ
on 0800 873 346
Find us in Person
46 Cron St
Franz Josef 7886
New Zealand
Google Maps
Minimising Our Footprint
We care deeply about this land, so while we aim to take huge strides we endeavour to leave few footprints.
As a proud New Zealand owned and operated company we have a strong investment in maintaining the nature and diversity of this beautiful land. Our environmental focus is a conscious choice but one that also feels completely natural when we acknowledge how integral the health of the planet is to all of us. This commitment is not only written into our company core values but is actively practiced through our purchasing, processes and guest services.
We have numerous sustainable measures in place, many you will notice, many you will not. We are constantly reviewing all aspects of our business to see how we can lesson our footprint. If you see an opportunity we may have missed, or would like to share an idea with us, we would love to hear from you. Please email me personally with your comments or suggestions, [email protected]
Sinead Lyons
General Manager and head of Rainforest sustainability
Tiaki Promise
Tiaki means to care for People and Place.
Rainforest is proud to promote the Tiaki Promise.
New Zealand is precious, and everyone who lives and travels here has a responsibility to look after it. The Tiaki Promise is a commitment to care for New Zealand, for now and for future generations.
By following the Tiaki Promise, you are making a commitment to New Zealand. To act as a guardian, protecting and preserving our home.
Nau Mai, Haere Mai Ki Aotearoa, Welcome to New Zealand.
Terms + Conditions
Reservations
RATES
All rates displayed are in NZ dollars and are
inclusive of taxes.
We use dynamic pricing and the price of our rooms,
products and services fluctuates based on demand and other factors. Before
confirming a reservation or purchase, we will provide you with a total price
for the requested number of rooms and nights, together with the charges for any
additional products or services you may have added. Depending on the room
rate selected, payment may be due at the time the reservation is made through
our site or at a later date, such as upon check-in at the hotel.
Unless otherwise indicated extras such as breakfast
and other gratuities are not included in the rate but you may be able to add
them to your reservation during the booking process or they may be available to
you during your stay.
PAYMENT
Payment of the full booking amount plus a security
deposit is taken as a credit card pre-authorisation at check-in. The
pre-authorised amount is set aside by the credit card company until check-out
when we complete payment, release the security deposit and charge any
additional room charges. This payment will be taken from the credit card
registered to the booking unless otherwise organised.
Guests wishing to pay with debit card or cash must
pre-pay the full booking amount at check-in. A credit card is still required
for the security deposit pre-authorisation. Please see below for further
information about pre-authorisation.
Rainforest Retreat are not responsible for currency
conversion and therefore any questions regarding currency conversion must be
directed to your credit card company.
PRE-AUTHORISATION & DEPOSIT
All reservations must be guaranteed with a valid
credit card at time of booking. We pre-authorise all credit cards for a nominal
amount on the day of booking to check for validity and sufficiency of funds.
Please note this process validates the presented credit card, and protects both
the cardholder and merchant from increasing fraud incidents. A deposit is not
required at time of booking, except for Agent and Advance Rate Group Bookings.
We may pre-authorise a credit card for any charges we
determine that the guest may be likely to consume during their stay. This may
also include an amount to cover a security bond / deposit for damages. The
pre-authorised amount is set aside by the credit card company for a period of
up to 10-days. The pre-authorisation will affect your available funds and / or
spending limit. For more information on this practice we suggest the cardholder
contact their card issuer. No money is taken from your credit card but it will
show as a ‘Pending Transaction’ and you may choose to use a different payment
type to pay your final bill.
CANCELLATION POLICY
We require minimum of 48 hours’ notice prior to the
date of arrival for all cancellations or amendments to accommodation
reservations.
Any change to the arrival date, departure date or room
type of this reservation is subject to the hotels’ availability at the time the
change is requested and may result in a possible rate change or an additional
fee.
Non-refundable bookings have no option to cancel or
receive a refund at a later date.
Bookings made via an online agent such as Booking.com,
Expedia or Ctrip must be cancelled by the guest via this agent before Rainforest
Retreat is able to formally cancel the booking.
Rainforest Retreat will operate within the Consumer
Guarantees Act & Fair-Trading Act.
OUR RIGHT TO CANCEL
We may cancel your reservation at any time with
immediate effect by giving you written notice (which includes e-mail) if you do
not pay us when you are required to do so or you breach the contract between us
in any other material way. If we cancel your reservation where you are at
fault, we reserve our legal rights in respect of your breach of contract.

How Many Nights Should You Stay in Franz Josef? A 1, 2 and 3 Night Itinerary - Rainforest Retreat
Skip to content
How Many Nights Should You Stay in Franz Josef? A 1, 2 and 3 Night Itinerary
How Many Nights Should You Stay in Franz Josef? A 1, 2 and 3 Night Itinerary
Planning a South Island road trip and wondering how many nights you should stay in Franz Josef?
For most travellers, we recommend spending at least two nights in Franz Josef , with three nights or more giving you the best chance to experience Glacier Country properly.
One night can work if you are very short on time, but it leaves little flexibility if weather affects a glacier heli-hike or scenic flight.
Staying longer gives you time for more than the glacier. You can explore rainforest walks, Lake Mapourika, wildlife experiences, Ōkārito and other outdoor activities, while still having time to relax between adventures.
How many nights should you stay in Franz Josef?
Here is the short answer:
1 night in Franz Josef: Best only if your itinerary is very tight and you are comfortable with the possibility of missing a glacier flight or heli-hike if the weather does not cooperate.
2 nights in Franz Josef: A good option for most travellers. You get one full day to experience Franz Josef and some flexibility around weather-dependent activities.
3 nights or more in Franz Josef: The best choice if you want to properly experience the area, enjoy outdoor activities and give yourself more opportunities to reschedule glacier experiences if needed.
There is easily enough to do in and around Franz Josef to fill several days.
Franz Josef Wilderness Tours Kayaking at Lake Mapourika
What can you do with 1 night in Franz Josef?
One night is possible if your South Island itinerary is very tight, but it is not what we would recommend if you want to properly experience Franz Josef.
If you are only staying one night, make the glacier your priority.
Arrival day: Make the glacier your priority
If seeing Franz Josef Glacier is one of the main reasons for your visit, make this your first priority.
The best way to properly experience the glacier is by air.
A scenic helicopter flight gives you sweeping views across the glacier, surrounding valleys and Southern Alps.
Franz Josef Glacier Guides heli-hike combines a helicopter flight with a guided walk on the glacier itself, giving you the chance to experience the ice up close.
There are short walks and viewpoints around the Franz Josef Glacier valley, but these only offer limited views of the glacier itself.
If your budget allows, a scenic flight or heli-hike gives you a much better sense of the scale and landscape of Franz Josef Glacier.
These experiences are weather dependent, which is the main downside of staying for only one night.
Franz Josef Glacier Guides, Heli Hiking
Later in the day: Explore Franz Josef
If time allows, spend the rest of your day exploring more of the local area.
You could:
Walk one of the short rainforest tracks around Franz Josef
Visit the Franz Josef Glacier valley viewpoints
Explore Peter’s Pool reflections or Sentinel Rock walk
Visit the West Coast Wildlife Centre and see a Kiwi bird
Spend time back at Rainforest Retreat using the spa pools and sauna
Finish the evening with dinner at Monsoon Restaurant & Bar .
Is 2 nights enough in Franz Josef?
For most travellers, two nights is a good amount of time to spend in Franz Josef .
It gives you one full day to experience the area, plus your arrival and departure days.
It also gives you some flexibility if the weather affects a glacier flight or heli-hike.
Arrival day: Settle in and explore locally
After arriving in Franz Josef, check in and spend some time exploring the village and nearby rainforest.
Depending on what time you arrive, you could:
Visit the West Coast Wildlife Centre
Take a short rainforest walk
Visit Peter’s Pool or Sentinel Rock
Spend some time at Rainforest Retreat
Enjoy the spa pools and sauna
Have dinner at Monsoon Restaurant & Bar
If you arrive early enough and conditions are suitable, you could also book your glacier experience for this afternoon.
Full day: Franz Josef Glacier and another local experience
Make your glacier experience the main focus of your full day.
If you want to properly see Franz Josef Glacier, a scenic helicopter flight or heli-hike is the best option.
Book your glacier activity as early in your stay as possible. If the weather is not suitable for flying, you may still have another opportunity before you leave.
After your flight or heli-hike, explore one of the local rainforest walks or another Franz Josef activity.
Shorter walks include:
Peter’s Pool
Sentinel Rock
Terrace Walk
Minnehaha Walk
If you have more time, you could also explore:
Callery Gorge Walk
Lake Wombat Walk
Tatare Tunnels Walk
Another great option is Lake Mapourika , where you can join a kayaking trip or scenic cruise with Franz Josef Wilderness Tours . If you want something more adventurous, you could also book a guided quad bike tour through rainforest tracks and the glacial riverbed.
Finish the day back at Rainforest Retreat with the spa pools, sauna and dinner at Monsoon.
Departure day: Keep your morning flexible
If your glacier experience could not operate the day before, use your departure morning as another opportunity if timing allows.
Otherwise, fit in a short walk, breakfast or one final local experience before continuing your road trip.
What can you do with 3 nights in Franz Josef?
Three nights gives you the best balance of activities, flexibility and time to enjoy Glacier Country without rushing.
If you enjoy nature, wildlife and outdoor experiences, this is the option we would recommend.
Arrival day: Ease into Franz Josef
After arriving, keep your first day simple.
You could visit the West Coast Wildlife Centre, take a short walk, spend some time at Rainforest Retreat or book a glacier flight if the weather is good and timing works.
